THE WORKSHEET GENERATOR

Word search maker.

Pick a shelf of words from our classes, or type your own. Every shuffle makes a brand-new puzzle — solve it on the screen, print it, or save it as a picture.

Build the puzzle

Words come from the shelves our classes teach, or from your own list. Every shuffle makes a new layout.

Puzzle size
Which ways can words hide?

FOR GROWN-UPS

Solve on screen turns the grid into a gentle game: your child taps the first and last letter of a word they spot, and the whole word lights up and ticks off the list. Nothing is scored or stored — the puzzle is theirs. Print opens just the sheet on A4 or US Letter (with the answer page behind it when the box is ticked), and the picture buttons save PNG files you can drop into a slide, a message or a folder for later. The word shelves follow our classes: habitat animals from Class 36, helpers from Class 33, weather words from Class 34.
